title: Forty-one routes and one forgotten copy
description: Fourteen services, forty-one routers, and a copy of the shop route left in routes/archive-2025/ with another router name and a higher priority. The file provider loads sub-folders too, so the copy would win silently.
pass_criterion: Verdict BLOCKED, exit code 2, exactly one finding that names both files; 42 entries as loaded, table not accepted, no finding on the other forty routes. With the copy set aside the same tree is accepted with 41 entries.
lesson: A recursive provider loads what was forgotten; the lint names both files instead of picking a winner.
